description: Java class 'ZipSalesServices' providing services for importing tax tables and calculating sales tax based on zip code, city, and state, within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ZipSalesServices
classes.description: Provides methods for importing zip sales tax data and calculating sales tax adjustments based on location and rules.

methods.name: importFlatTable
methods.description: Imports tax tables and rules from specified XML data files into the database, with security checks.

methods.name: flatTaxCalc
methods.description: Calculates sales tax adjustments for items and shipping based on zip code, city, and state.

methods.name: getItemTaxList
methods.description: Helper method to determine applicable tax adjustments for a specific item or shipping amount based on lookup data and rules.

methods.name: parseDate
methods.description: Parses a date string in 'yyyyMMdd' format into a Timestamp object, with fallback to a default timestamp.
